request: Wait for images before entering trainer battles in the Battle House
cause: The existing entrance cover had a2.4-second asset deadline and revealed a House encounter with downloads still pending. Reproduced in a real PvE encounter after3200ms.

changes.loader: Reuse BattleEntrance, with a rotating Poké Ball and explicit image-loading caption; reduced motion keeps it static. Scene and actions remain hidden/inert during loading.
changes.preload: Deduplicate front/back sprites of the registered own team and the selected trainer catalogue species, plus the actual DOM background/platform/current fighters. Existing image readiness waits for load and decode and handles picture-source changes.
changes.privacy: Trainer species come exclusively from the catalogue already visible in selection. No new data request; hidden PvP parties are never exposed. Own copies may contain12 Pokémon in collaborative formats.
changes.timeouts: House safety bound increased from2400 to12000ms. Missing images/failed decodes settle as before; a permanently stalled connection cannot block the UI indefinitely. Other encounters keep2400ms.
changes.cancellation: Existing abort controller/visual epoch cancels pending listeners and ignores obsolete completions after reset/reconnection.
changes.gameplay: No server, deadline, battle, rewards, owned team, score, SQL or authored asset changes.

baseline.expectedFailure: House loader revealed before slow assets loaded: count0 rather than1 after3200ms

chromium.serviceWorkers: blocked in fixture so intercepted images are actually cold; no production service worker change

webkit.serviceWorkers: blocked in fixture so intercepted images are actually cold; no production service worker change

validation.database: explorakit_test exclusively, temporary users removed in finally

reproduce: DB_TEST_NAME=explorakit_test RELEASE_DIST_DIR=/tmp/riftmon-house-loader-dist node --env-file=.env scripts/validateHouseEntranceBrowser.js ; run again sequentially with PRESENTATION_BROWSER=webkit. RELEASE_SCREENSHOTS selects a separate artifact directory. Run only on the dedicated test database.
